servicesPage.intro: From routine oil changes to complex engine repairs, Dallas Auto Service offers a full range of auto repair services. Our certified technicians use the latest tools and techniques to keep your vehicle running safely and efficiently. Explore our services below and schedule your appointment today.

services.title: Brake Repair & Service
services.shortDescription: Expert brake inspection, repair, and replacement to ensure your safety on the road.
services.longDescription: Your brakes are your vehicle's most critical safety system. At Dallas Auto Service, we provide comprehensive brake services including pad and rotor replacement, caliper repair, brake fluid flush, and ABS diagnostics. We use high-quality parts and precise techniques to restore stopping power and peace of mind.
benefits: Reduced risk of costly rotor damage

process.title: Thorough Inspection
process.description: We check pads, rotors, calipers, lines, and fluid levels to identify all issues.

process.title: Transparent Recommendation
process.description: We explain the condition of each component and provide a clear estimate with options.

process.title: Precision Service
process.description: Our technicians perform the repair using quality parts and test drive to ensure perfect operation.

faqs.question: How often should I replace my brake pads?
faqs.answer: Typically every 30,000 to 70,000 miles, depending on driving habits and conditions. We check them during every service.

faqs.question: What are signs of brake problems?
faqs.answer: Squealing, grinding, vibration, a soft pedal, or longer stopping distances. Bring your car in if you notice any of these.

services.title: Engine Diagnostics & Repair
services.shortDescription: Accurate diagnostics and expert repairs for check engine lights and performance issues.
services.longDescription: When your check engine light comes on or your car isn't performing as it should, trust our diagnostic expertise. We use advanced scanners and experience to pinpoint the root cause—whether it's a sensor, fuel system, ignition, or mechanical issue. We then provide a clear plan for repair using quality parts.
benefits: Accurate diagnosis saves time and money
Restored engine performance and fuel efficiency
Prevention of minor issues becoming major repairs
Warranty-backed repairs for peace of mind

process.title: Computer Scan & Analysis
process.description: We connect diagnostic tools to read error codes and live data from your engine.

process.title: In-Depth Testing
process.description: We perform additional tests (compression, vacuum, fuel pressure) to confirm the issue.

process.title: Repair & Verification
process.description: We fix the problem and test drive to ensure the repair resolves the issue completely.

faqs.question: Can you diagnose any check engine light?
faqs.answer: Yes, we have the equipment and expertise to diagnose all makes and models, including hybrid and diesel systems.

faqs.question: How long does a diagnostic take?
faqs.answer: Most diagnostics take about an hour. We'll provide a detailed report of findings and recommendations.

services.title: Oil Change & Lube Services
services.shortDescription: Quick, professional oil changes using quality oils and filters to protect your engine.
services.longDescription: Regular oil changes are the simplest yet most important maintenance for your vehicle. We offer conventional, synthetic blend, and full synthetic oil changes, always including a new filter and a complimentary multi-point inspection. Our service is fast, thorough, and helps extend engine life.

process.title: Drain Old Oil & Replace Filter
process.description: We drain the old oil and replace it with fresh oil and a new quality filter.

process.title: Multi-Point Inspection
process.description: We check fluid levels, belts, hoses, tires, and lights, noting any concerns.

process.title: Top-Off & Clean Up
process.description: We top off all fluids and clean any spills, leaving your car ready to go.

faqs.question: What type of oil does my car need?
faqs.answer: We recommend the oil grade specified in your owner's manual. We carry conventional, synthetic blend, and full synthetic options.

faqs.question: How often should I get an oil change?
faqs.answer: Most modern cars need an oil change every 5,000 to 7,500 miles. Older vehicles may require more frequent changes.

services.title: Tire Services & Alignment
services.shortDescription: Tire rotation, balancing, and alignment to maximize tire life and handling.
services.longDescription: Proper tire care is essential for safety, fuel economy, and ride comfort. We offer tire rotation, balancing, and wheel alignment services. Our technicians use precision equipment to ensure your tires wear evenly and your vehicle handles correctly. We also provide tire repair and replacement recommendations.
benefits: Extended tire life and even wear

process.title: Tire Inspection & Pressure Check
process.description: We inspect tread depth, sidewall condition, and adjust pressure to manufacturer specs.

process.title: Rotation & Balancing
process.description: We rotate tires according to pattern and balance each wheel to eliminate vibration.

process.title: Precision Alignment
process.description: Using a laser alignment machine, we adjust camber, caster, and toe to factory specifications.

faqs.question: How often should I rotate my tires?
faqs.answer: Every 5,000 to 7,500 miles, or as recommended in your owner's manual. We include rotation with oil changes.

faqs.question: What are signs of alignment issues?
faqs.answer: Pulling to one side, uneven tire wear, a crooked steering wheel, or vibration. If you notice any, schedule an alignment.

about.headline: Your Trusted Dallas Auto Repair Shop Since 2000
about.mission: To provide honest, high-quality auto repair services that keep our customers safe and their vehicles reliable. We believe in transparent communication, fair pricing, and craftsmanship.
story: Dallas Auto Service was founded in 2000 by master technician John Miller, who wanted to create a shop where customers could trust every recommendation. Starting with just two bays, John built a reputation for diagnosing problems accurately and fixing them right the first time. Over two decades, we've grown into a full-service repair facility serving thousands of Dallas drivers.

Today, our team of ASE-certified technicians continues John's legacy of integrity and expertise. We invest in the latest diagnostic equipment and ongoing training to service all makes and models. Whether you need a simple oil change or a complex engine repair, we treat your car with the same care as our own. We're proud to be a trusted part of the Dallas community.
